title: What a matrix does to space
lede: A cube and a sphere are carried from the identity to the matrix you choose. The three arrows show where the basis vectors go.
notice: Every straight line stays straight and the origin stays put. That is what linear means.
The determinant is the factor by which volume changes. It is negative when space is flipped and zero when it is flattened.
With the projection, the rank drops to 2: a whole dimension of the sphere is lost, and no matrix can bring it back.
hint: Drag to rotate. Press Play to watch the transformation happen.
